title.zh: 在萨马省第三区设立街区的法案
title.en: An Act Creating Barrios in the Third District of the Province of Samar
title.orig: An Act Creating Barrios in the Third District of the Province of Samar

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2746_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Libertad in the Municipality of Dolores, Province of Samar, is converted into a barrio of said municipality, to be known as the barrio of Libertad.

The sitios of Camada, Guindalitan and Tagaslian in the Municipality of Maydolong, Province of Samar, are converted into barrios of said municipality, to be known as the barrios of Camada, Guindalitan and Tagaslian, respectively.
The sitio of Cambilla in the Municipality of Quinapundan, Province of Samar, is converted into a barrio of said municipality, to be known as the barrio of Cambilla.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
